verdict.rationale: The only rollback evidence is "Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds," which describes Sprite agent-sandbox checkpoints. That is an adjacent feature, not a documented way to roll back a deployed Fly app or service to a previous release version. Nothing in the pack describes release history, version rollback via flyctl, or a one-click rollback in a dashboard for deployed services.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click
